title: Business Add-Ins (BAdIs)
raw_text:

e EMDKOOOI1 (IS-U utility contract: include subscreens and check fields)

1 Note

You can find these enhancements in Customizing under |sSAP Utilities } Tools System Modifications } SAP Enhancements
Define SAP Enhancements

Business Add-Ins (BAdIs)
e ISU_MOVEIN_CUSTOMIZE: (IS-U: Customizing — override move-in processing)
Used to override Customizing settings in the move-in.
For more information see the Badl documentation.
e ISU_MOVEIN_MENUE (IS-U: menu enhancement for move-in)
Used to enhance the menu of the move-in screen. Enables you to add entries to the menu bar.
For more information see the Badl documentation.
e ISU_MOVEOUT_MENUE (IS-U: menu enhancement for move-out)
Used to enhance the menu of the move-out screen. Enables you to add entries to the menu bar.

For more information see the Badl documentation.

Contract Change without Invoicing

Use

The function for changing a contract without invoicing enables you to change the payment form of some of the contracts ina
contract account without triggering separate invoicing.

Integration

You can use the contract change without invoicing from the move-in/out function. You can also reverse a contract change without
invoicing.

Prerequisites

You can use the contract change without invoicing function in a move-in/out when the contracts have already been included in an
invoiced billing document.

Prerequisite: You have configured the contract change reasons in Customizing under Define Reasons forContract Change so that

the new field nl (contract change without invoicing) is selected. The settings for reposting receivables during the customer
change also have to be maintained here in the field UBU (Repost Open Items for Move-In/Out).
